# LMU Computer Science

> Patrick King's BS Computer Science coursework from Loyola Marymount University, Fall 2021 to Spring 2025: fifteen CMSI courses, 18 languages counted by line, and the code itself rather than links to it. Highlights are CloudScribe, a four-stage Ohm compiler to JavaScript (CMSI 3802); seven Rust networking projects ending in a libp2p peer-to-peer trading card network (CMSI 3550); and Pathfinder, the two-semester senior project (CMSI 4071 and 4072). Each has a case study on the site. Coursework under src/courses is kept exactly as submitted, defects included. A static Astro site presents it and runs some programs in the browser.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/README.md): the three projects, the course map, and how it is checked
- [Architecture](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): six Mermaid diagrams, one per project plus the repository, the course progression and the browser playground
- [Course map](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/docs/course-map.md): generated timeline, courses by term, and the language by course matrix
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands and rules for working in the repository
- [Building the coursework](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/docs/building.md): the 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 suite matrices with toolchain versions, build and test commands, and recorded defects
- [Course record](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/docs/record.md): the authoritative course, term and title list
- [Contributing](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): fixes only; this is a personal archive

## Live demo

- [Site](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/): the coursework, presented
- [Programs](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/programs/): the CloudScribe compiler and a calculator running in the page
- [Case study: CloudScribe](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/projects/cloudscribe/): problem, approach, pipeline, and what the tests missed
- [Case study: the network stack](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/projects/network-stack/): the libp2p layers and request and response over Floodsub
- [Case study: Pathfinder](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/projects/pathfinder/): the senior project as submitted, and what I would do differently
- [Courses](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/courses/): every course by year, and by language
- [How the site works](https://patrickking67.github.io/lmu-computer-science/wiki/how-the-site-works/): run modes and why a WebContainer cannot be embedded

## Source

- [Courses](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/courses): one directory per course, as submitted
- [CloudScribe compiler](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/courses/cmsi-3802/cloudscribe): course-era snapshot
- [Networking projects](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/courses/cmsi-3550): Rust
- [Pathfinder](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/courses/cmsi-4072/Pathfinder): senior project
- [Site source](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/dashboard): Astro and Tailwind
- [lmucs](https://github.com/patrickking67/lmu-computer-science/tree/main/src/packages/lmucs): Python package that verifies the record and counts lines
